decisions.reason: Because submarine interior lighting is distant from the firm's core lighting range, was only lightly featured, and is not central to the publicly stated LED-focused growth path, management would be less inclined to keep committing resources to it.

Although medically oriented lighting builds on the firm's capabilities, its disappearance from the website after launch suggests weak traction and limited visible commitment, making it easier to abandon despite the initial investment.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires fit the firm's established industrial customer base, received sustained standalone promotion and follow-on product development, and therefore invite continued commitment even if performance has been mixed.
The designer task light is close to the existing offer, was relaunched publicly as a popular product and kept on its own page, so prior responsibility and visible commitment support continuing it.

The pendant office luminaire is close to the core business and the firm's announced direction toward innovative, energy-efficient workplace lighting, so management would likely continue backing it while attributing any early shortfalls to ramp-up effects.

The premium pendant luminaire is likewise close to the established portfolio and strategically aligned with the firm's quality-focused professional lighting position, which encourages persistence after launch investments.
